summary: The revised gap analysis (Version 2.0) successfully addresses all critical issues from the previous failed verification. All five false gap claims have been corrected: random-events.md (1628 lines), components-complete.md (583 lines), weapons-complete.md (900 lines), victory-conditions.md (1395 lines), and slider-mathematics.md (737 lines) are now correctly acknowledged as existing comprehensive specifications. The methodology section now documents proper file inventory using find commands. Coverage percentages are reasonable (93% overall). Remaining gaps are genuine and appropriately marked as low-priority polish items. The document now accurately represents the project's production-ready status. Minor line count discrepancies do not impact the document's core value as an accurate gap analysis.
